light: Neutral soft upper-left daylight, without environment-colour spill.

retry_gate: Material source defect only, after safe local repair/reuse is ruled out. At most three global attempts including historical sheets. Reviewed diagnostics stay offline; upload clean accepted authority. Recompile ambiguous prompts with a recorded semantic diff. Third attempt requires a changed mechanism, no-cost feasibility evidence, finite spend window and lineage_guard pass. Never reset attempts by renaming.
